{{Quote|The Kowakian monkey-lizard is usually a trickster by nature, but can also be a loyal pet. Skreech is no exception.|Store description|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''Skreech''' was a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] that lived at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was kept as a pet by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].

==Behind the scenes==
Skreech is a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players of the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. He can be bought for 450 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]].
